name: Ipponnoki Foundation grant
summary: Grants to non-profit groups or individuals based in Kumamoto Prefecture for protecting wildlife, forests, water and local landscapes, covering up to half of eligible costs.

amount.note: Up to half of eligible costs

reporting: A project results report within 30 days of finishing the project.

eligibility.rule: Have an address in Kumamoto Prefecture
Organisations have provisions for purpose, structure, representative and operations
Not be a corporation capitalised or endowed by government or companies
Run a non-profit project unrelated to political or religious activities
No staff wages, routine costs, self-promotion, recreation food or items costing ¥100,000+ including tax
Receive no more than one grant per year; continuation requires special approval and is limited to 3 years

documents: Constitution or bylaws, and list of officers and members
Location map of the activity site(s)
Quotes or price lists for planned purchases, leases or contracts

calls.label: Projects running April to September
